item.title: Dialkyl side-chain length controls molecular orientation, charge-transport balance, and recombination in backbone-identical polymer donors for organic solar cells
item.description:
Authors: Dongki Lee, Hansol Lee, Hyeongjin Hwang

Extending the dialkyl side chains enhances neat-film ordering and hole transport, but progressively disrupts transport balance in Y6 blends, leading to poorer photovoltaic performance.

item.title: Efficient orange-red room-temperature phosphorescence from undoped conjugated polymers based on intramolecularly locked phenoselenazine units
item.description:
Authors: Zhiqiang Cheng, Shanhui Gao, Xiaofu Wu, Shumeng Wang, Hui Tong, Lixiang Wang

Intramolecularly locked phenoselenazine-based conjugated polymers achieve long-wavelength RTP up to 597 nm in undoped films. Further introducing electron-donating carbazole units leads to a high Φ Ph of 25.0% and superior oxygen sensitivity.

DOI: 10.1039/d6tc03293a
